model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the 'effect' associated with different language families, as measured across several models. The horizontal axis displays language families, arranged in the order IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the 'effect' value and is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Three models are compared: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, and mBERT-B2, each represented by a distinct color – teal for mBERT-L2, green for XLM-L2, and dark red for mBERT-B2.  Each language family has three bars corresponding to the three models. For example, the IE-Baltic language family has a teal bar with a value of approximately 8, a green bar with a value of roughly 12, and a dark red bar with an approximate value of 10. Error bars are present for each bar, indicating the variability in the 'effect' for each model within each language family;  for instance, the error bar for the teal mBERT-L2 bar for the IE-Baltic family extends from approximately 5 to 11. The bars are not sorted in any order beyond the order of the language families on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
